title: Advanced Sunlight Shadow Analysis with Scoring
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements an advanced sunlight shadow analysis tool for an architectural scene. The tool simulates sun position throughout the day and scores building placements based on shadow coverage.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use an OrbitControls camera starting at position (40, 30, 40) looking at origin.
- Create a ground plane (100x100 units) with a grid texture, receiving shadows.
- Place 3 buildings as box geometries:
  - Building A: position (-15, 5, -10), size (8, 10, 8), color #4a90d9
  - Building B: position (10, 7.5, 5), size (6, 15, 6), color #d94a4a
  - Building C: position (-5, 3, 12), size (10, 6, 10), color #4ad94a
- All buildings cast and receive shadows.
- Create a target analysis zone as a semi-transparent yellow plane (20x20) at position (5, 0.05, -8) representing a park/garden area that needs sunlight.
- Add a DirectionalLight simulating the sun with shadow mapping enabled (shadow map size 2048x2048, shadow camera frustum covering the scene).
- The sun orbits in a semicircle simulating sunrise (East, hour=6) to sunset (West, hour=18), with elevation peaking at noon (hour=12).

SUN POSITION CALCULATION:
- Hour range: 6.0 to 18.0 (continuous float)
- Sun azimuth angle: map hour 6-18 to angle -90 to +90 degrees (East to West)
- Sun elevation: sin curve peaking at 60 degrees at noon, 0 at sunrise/sunset
- Sun distance from origin: 50 units
- Position: x = distance * cos(elevation) * sin(azimuth), y = distance * sin(elevation), z = -distance * cos(elevation) * cos(azimuth)

SHADOW ANALYSIS:
- Sample the analysis zone with a 5x5 grid of raycaster points (25 sample points evenly distributed across the 20x20 zone).
- For each sample point, cast a ray toward the sun. If it intersects any building, that point is in shadow.
- Calculate shadow_percentage = (shadowed_points / 25) * 100
- Calculate sunlight_score = 100 - shadow_percentage (higher is better for the park)

TIME CONTROLS:
- A slider (id='timeSlider') ranging from 6.0 to 18.0 with step 0.1 to control the hour.
- A label (id='timeLabel') showing current time in format 'HH:MM' (e.g., '14:30').
- A 'Play' button (id='playBtn') that animates time from current to 18:00 at 2 hours per second.
- A 'Reset' button (id='resetBtn') that sets time back to 6:00 and stops animation.

DAILY ANALYSIS:
- A button (id='analyzeBtn') labeled 'Run Full Day Analysis' that samples shadow at every 0.5 hour increment from 6 to 18 (25 samples) and computes:
  - average_score: mean sunlight_score across all samples
  - worst_hour: the hour with lowest sunlight_score
  - best_hour: the hour with highest sunlight_score
  - morning_avg (6-12), afternoon_avg (12-18)

BUILDING INTERACTION:
- Click on a building to select it (outline or color change). Selected building can be moved with arrow keys (Left/Right = X axis ±1 unit, Up/Down = Z axis ±1 unit).
- After moving, shadow analysis auto-updates for current time.
- A 'Score' button (id='scoreBtn') recalculates the current shadow analysis.

HUD DISPLAY:
- Top-left panel showing: current hour, sun elevation, sun azimuth, shadow_percentage, sunlight_score.
- After full day analysis: show average_score, worst_hour, best_hour.

STATE MANAGEMENT - Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- currentHour (float, 6.0-18.0)
- sunPosition: {x, y, z}
- sunElevationDeg (float, degrees)
- sunAzimuthDeg (float, degrees)
- shadowPercentage (float, 0-100)
- sunlightScore (float, 0-100)
- selectedBuilding (null or 'A'|'B'|'C')
- buildingPositions: {A: {x,y,z}, B: {x,y,z}, C: {x,y,z}}
- isAnimating (boolean)
- analysisComplete (boolean)
- averageScore (float or null)
- worstHour (float or null)
- bestHour (float or null)
- morningAvg (float or null)
- afternoonAvg (float or null)
- shadowSamples (integer, count of shadowed points 0-25)
- totalSamplePoints (25)

Ensure all shadow calculations are NaN-free. Sun elevation must never go negative. Scores must be clamped 0-100.
physics_constraints: Sun follows semicircular arc: elevation = 60 * sin(pi * (hour-6)/12) degrees, azimuth = -90 + 180*(hour-6)/12 degrees. Shadow percentage must be 0-100. Sunlight score = 100 - shadow_percentage. Building positions constrained to ground plane bounds (-45 to 45 on X and Z). Sun Y coordinate must always be >= 0. Average score must equal mean of all sampled scores. Morning and afternoon averages must partition correctly at hour 12.
